title: 听力挑战 · 描述事故经过

rounds.speaker: 警察
rounds.line: Can you tell me what exactly happened at the crossing?
rounds.lineCn: 你能告诉我十字路口到底发生了什么吗?

grammar.name: 现在分词作时间状语
grammar.note: Hearing the horn 现在分词短语作状语,表示'听到喇叭时'。

options.text: Hearing the horn, the driver stopped the van.
options.feedback: 分词短语作时间状语,描述事发经过准确。

options.text: The driver will stop at the next crossing.
options.feedback: 将来时谈之后的动作,不是事发经过。

options.text: The crossing is very busy every day.
options.feedback: 一般现在时谈常态,没有描述事故。

rounds.speaker: 警察
rounds.line: Was anyone badly hurt in the accident yesterday afternoon, Tom?
rounds.lineCn: 汤姆,昨天下午的事故里有人伤得很重吗?

grammar.name: 过去分词作状语
grammar.note: Shaken but safe 过去分词短语作伴随状语,补充说明伤情。

options.text: Shaken but safe, everyone walked away.
options.feedback: 分词短语作伴随状语,说明无人重伤。
一般现在时谈日常,与事故无关。
混淆事故时间,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 目击者
rounds.line: How did the police react when they arrived at the scene?
rounds.lineCn: 警察到达现场后是怎么反应的?

grammar.name: 完成式分词作状语
grammar.note: Having closed the road 表示动作先于主句发生,作时间状语。

options.text: Having closed the road, they checked the damage.
options.feedback: 完成式分词表示先后顺序,描述反应准确。

options.text: They will close the road tomorrow.
options.feedback: 将来时谈计划,不是现场反应。

options.text: The police arrived late last night.
options.feedback: 谈到达时间,没有描述反应动作。
